findings.description: The bucket is explicitly noted as public with no ACL restriction or public access block configured, allowing anyone to read or write objects including sensitive customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket (including customer-master.xlsx) are not encrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, so accidental or malicious deletion/overwrite of objects cannot be recovered, increasing risk from data tampering.
A sensitive file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded into the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, exposing customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled, risking permanent loss or undetected tampering of financial data objects.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, leaving data science bucket contents unencrypted at rest.
